# Liebherr HomeAPI fixtures

Answers of the Liebherr SmartDevice HomeAPI, shaped after the official OpenAPI
specification (`openapi.json` of
[pyliebherrhomeapi](https://github.com/mettolen/pyliebherrhomeapi), MIT) and
the test data of the Home Assistant `liebherr` integration (Apache-2.0): enums
in capitals as the API writes them, zone positions in lowercase.

The serial numbers (`deviceId`), nicknames and image URLs are invented. The
`futurecontrol` entry stands for a control type Liebherr could add later: it
must be ignored.
